heroSubtitle: Competitive youth football for 5th, 6th, 7th, and 8th graders in Oshkosh, Wisconsin
mission: To promote sportsmanship, teamwork, and good citizenship. Focusing on core fundamentals and safe techniques through dedication and self discipline.
volunteerNote: Flyer families are encouraged to pitch in at home games. Each family is asked to participate through volunteer spots and/or donations, with a minimum of 2 volunteer spots per family.
